title: Exact augmented sheafified free presheaf Čech nerve
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a category with morphisms in universe $v$, let $J$ be a Grothendieck topology, and assume sheafification of $v$-valued abelian presheaves exists [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Let $f:E\to P$ be a locally surjective map of $v$-valued presheaves of sets. Let $N_n=E\times_P\cdots\times_PE$ with $n+1$ factors and let $A_n=(\mathbb Z[N_n])^\#$, with alternating-face differential $d_{n+1}:A_{n+1}\to A_n$ [def-sc-presheaf-cech-complex]. There exist abelian sheaves $K_n$, maps $i_n:K_n\to A_n$ and $p_n:A_{n+1}\to K_n$, and an isomorphism $e_0:A_0\simeq(\mathbb Z[E])^\#$, such that $0\to K_0\xrightarrow{i_0}A_0\xrightarrow{Z[f]\circ e_0}(\mathbb Z[P])^\#\to0$ and $0\to K_{n+1}\xrightarrow{i_{n+1}}A_{n+1}\xrightarrow{p_n}K_n\to0$ are short exact, and $i_n\circ p_n=d_{n+1}$ for every $n\geq0$. No coefficient sheaf, cohomological degree, or Ext vanishing is assumed.

source.place: Tag 01GC (lemma-compare-cosk0), with Tag 079Z (presheaf descent); read the published Stacks pages.

proof.text: Use [lem-sc-presheaf-cech-sheaf-positive-exact] for positive-degree exactness of the actual complex. Use [lem-sc-presheaf-cech-sheaf-augmentation-exact] for the canonical augmentation zero relation, exactness and epimorphy.

Define the outgoing map g_0 to be the augmentation and g_(n+1) to be d_(n+1). Put S_n=(A_(n+1)→A_n→codomain(g_n)); these short complexes are exact. Construct K_n as S_n.cycles, i_n as iCycles and p_n as toCycles. These are actual canonical kernel constructions; the only postponed input concerns their properties. Exact.epi_toCycles proves p_n epic, while iCycles is monic and toCycles_i gives the differential identity. Cancel the monomorphism i_n to obtain i_(n+1)≫p_n=0. Compare this short complex to the canonical kernel sequence of d_(n+1) by the identity in the first two positions and i_n in the third; exact_iff_of_epi_of_isIso_of_mono gives its exactness, hence its short exactness.

Construct the degree-zero nerve isomorphism using its only projection and the diagonal wide-pullback lift, proving the inverse identities by hom_ext. Apply the free sheaf functor to this isomorphism. π_arrow and functoriality identify its augmentation with the canonical base-map augmentation. Transport the canonical kernel short exact sequence along this equality using ShortComplex.isoMk. All fields of PresheafCechSheafResolution are now filled by explicit data and proved identities.

proof_origin.place: Tag 01GC, Lemma 25.4.2 and its proof; checked at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01GC.
